Palette Storage: Indices Bit-Compression - voxel.wiki
Relation between a palettes size and the bit-size of any index/indices pointing into it. By reducing the bit-size of the individual indices to the minimum amount of bits needed, while still correctly pointing at their respective palette entries, the overall memory usage of voxel volumes is massively reduced, possibly by up to ~90% or more.
